title: Canonical truncated Koszul power system on an affine scheme
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $X=\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ [def-pc-scheme], and $f_1,\ldots,f_r\in A$. Put $U=\bigcup_iD(f_i)$. From the Koszul complex [def-weil-pbc-koszul-complex], for $e\ge1$ form $I_e^i=K^{i-1}(f_1^e,\ldots,f_r^e)$ for $i\le0$, zero otherwise, with negative Koszul differential. Its augmentation to $A[0]$ is the Koszul boundary $K_1\to K_0=A$. For $a\le b$ the comparison $I_b\to I_a$ in degree $-n$ is the exterior power of the diagonal map multiplying generator $i$ by $f_i^{b-a}$. Termwise associated sheaf and localization to $D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category] give the canonical objects, augmentations and comparisons. For $E\in D(\mathcal O_X)$, they give the directed diagram $e\mapsto\operatorname{Hom}(I_e,E)$ with transitions by precomposition. The full Koszul complex gives $K_e$ and the canonical inclusion $\mathcal O_X\to K_e$.

proof.text: For koszulOpenTail_square cancel the two negative signs using Preadditive.neg_comp and comp_neg, then apply ExteriorAlgebra.koszulBoundary_comp at degree n+1 from [def-weil-pbc-koszul-complex]. For the augmentation cycle, reassociate the composite, apply the same square-zero theorem at degree zero, and compose zero with the degree-zero exterior-power isomorphism.

Prove that exteriorPower.map agrees after subtype inclusion with ExteriorAlgebra.map: use exteriorPower.linearMap_ext and check the identity on exteriorPower.ιMulti via map_apply_ιMulti and ιMulti_apply_coe. Prove naturality of contraction for linear forms phi, psi and a linear endomorphism g with psi.comp g = phi by CliffordAlgebra.left_induction: scalar elements contract to zero; addition follows from linearity; for iota(v)*x apply contractLeft_ι_mul, the induction hypothesis, multiplicativity and scalar compatibility of ExteriorAlgebra.map, and psi(g(v))=phi(v). This uses the contraction model of [def-weil-pbc-koszul-complex].

Check on each Finsupp.single i x that the form for exponent a+1 composed with the diagonal for b-a is the form for b+1, using b-a+(a+1)=b+1 when a<=b and pow_add. For koszulOpenTransitionComponent_comm, if n=m+1 cancel the negative signs, include the exterior powers into the exterior algebra, and apply contraction naturality from the preceding step. Otherwise both differentials vanish by HomologicalComplex.shape.
For koszulOpenTilde_additive_proof, the maps of the transported functor are the tilde maps; tilde.map_add supplies the Additive field directly. No new sheaf-theoretic result is required.

Check on Finsupp.single that diagonal exponent zero is the identity and that diagonals for c-b and b-a compose to the one for c-a; use c-b+(b-a)=c-a and pow_add. ExteriorPower.map_id and map_comp give identity and composition for the chain maps, by HomologicalComplex.hom_ext. HomologicalComplex.extendMap_id and extendMap_comp, termwise tilde functor laws, and DerivedCategory.Q functor laws transport these to koszulOpenMap_laws in [def-pc-derived-category].

Apply function extensionality to each equation in koszulOpenHomDiagram_laws. The identity clause is koszulOpenMap_laws followed by Category.id_comp. The composition clause is Category.assoc and the composition clause of koszulOpenMap_laws. These give the existing directed Hom functor fields.
